name: OTPField
description:
A one-time code split into single-character slots.

  OTPField(length: 6, name: "code", aria_label: "Verification code") do
    6.times { |index| OTPFieldInput(aria_label: "Digit #{index + 1} of 6") }
  end

Typing fills the slots and moves on, Backspace clears and moves back, ←/→ move, and pasting (or the OS one-time-code autofill) spreads a code across the slots. A hidden input submits the joined value under `name:`. `validation_type:` (:numeric, :alpha, :alphanumeric, :none) filters what's accepted; `mask:` hides the characters; `auto_submit:` submits the form when complete. Emits `ui--otp-field:change` and `ui--otp-field:complete` with { value }.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `OTPField(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

OTPFieldInput.description: One slot of an OTPField: a single-character native input. Label each one (aria_label:).

OTPFieldSeparator.description: A divider between groups of OTPField slots - a dash unless given content.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code: phlex { OTPField(length: length.to_i, variant:, size:, validation_type:, name: "code", aria_label: "Verification code") { instance_exec(length.to_i, &SLOTS) } }

examples.name: Variants
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col gap-5") do
    %i[ outline soft ].each { |variant| OTPField(length: 6, variant:, aria_label: "#{variant} code") { instance_exec(6, &SLOTS) } }
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col items-center gap-5") do
    %i[ sm md lg ].each { |size| OTPField(length: 4, size:, aria_label: "#{size} code") { instance_exec(4, &SLOTS) } }
  end
end

examples.name: With a separator
examples.code:
phlex do
  OTPField(length: 6, aria_label: "Verification code") do
    3.times { |index| OTPFieldInput(aria_label: "Digit #{index + 1} of 6") }
    OTPFieldSeparator()
    3.upto(5) { |index| OTPFieldInput(aria_label: "Digit #{index + 1} of 6") }
  end
end

examples.name: Placeholder
examples.notes: A `placeholder:` on each slot shows while it's empty and unfocused.
examples.code: phlex { OTPField(length: 6, aria_label: "Verification code") { 6.times { |index| OTPFieldInput(placeholder: "•", aria_label: "Digit #{index + 1} of 6") } } }

examples.name: Masked
examples.code: phlex { OTPField(length: 6, mask: true, default_value: "135790", aria_label: "Masked code") { instance_exec(6, &SLOTS) } }

examples.name: Verify on complete
examples.notes: `ui--otp-field:complete` fires once every slot is filled. Try 123456 (or paste it).

examples.name: Disabled, read-only & error states
RTL
examples.notes: The code still reads left to right, as digits do.
examples.code: phlex { div(dir: "rtl") { OTPField(length: 4, dir: "ltr", aria_label: "رمز التحقق") { instance_exec(4, &SLOTS) } } }

example_helpers.SLOTS: SLOTS = proc { |length, prefix = "Digit"| length.times { |index| OTPFieldInput(aria_label: "#{prefix} #{index + 1} of #{length}") } }
